# Get Last Live Photos

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the last n live photos you took.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getLastLivePhoto(count: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getLastLivePhoto(count: 1)
~~~~
